sloka: ततः पंचवटीम् गत्वा नाना व्याल मृगायुताम् ।उवाच भ्रातरम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् दीप्त तेजसम् ॥३-१५-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ paṁcavaṭīm gatvā nānā vyāla mṛgāyutām ।uvāca bhrātaram rāmo lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam ॥3-15-1॥

translations.english: On reaching Panchavati, which was full of various vicious animals, Rama said to Lakshmana, his brother who was glowing like fire:
